name: backup-gateway
description: Backup gateway Backup gateway connects Backup to your hypervisor, so you can create, store, and restore backups of your virtual machines (VMs) anywhere, whether on-premises or in the VMware Cloud (VMC) on Amazon Web Services.

subcommands.name: associate-gateway-to-server
subcommands.description: Associates a backup gateway with your server.

subcommands.name: create-gateway
subcommands.description: Creates a backup gateway.

subcommands.name: delete-gateway
subcommands.description: Deletes a backup gateway.

subcommands.name: delete-hypervisor
subcommands.description: Deletes a hypervisor.

subcommands.name: disassociate-gateway-from-server
subcommands.description: Disassociates a backup gateway from the specified server.

subcommands.name: get-bandwidth-rate-limit-schedule
subcommands.description: Retrieves the bandwidth rate limit schedule for a specified gateway.

subcommands.name: get-gateway
subcommands.description: By providing the ARN (Amazon Resource Name), this API returns the gateway.

subcommands.name: get-hypervisor
subcommands.description: This action requests information about the specified hypervisor to which the gateway will connect.

subcommands.name: get-hypervisor-property-mappings
subcommands.description: This action retrieves the property mappings for the specified hypervisor.

subcommands.name: get-virtual-machine
subcommands.description: By providing the ARN (Amazon Resource Name), this API returns the virtual machine.

subcommands.name: import-hypervisor-configuration
subcommands.description: Connect to a hypervisor by importing its configuration.

subcommands.name: list-gateways
subcommands.description: Lists backup gateways owned by an Amazon Web Services account in an Amazon Web Services Region.

subcommands.name: list-hypervisors
subcommands.description: Lists your hypervisors.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Lists the tags applied to the resource identified by its Amazon Resource Name (ARN).

subcommands.name: list-virtual-machines
subcommands.description: Lists your virtual machines.

subcommands.name: put-bandwidth-rate-limit-schedule
subcommands.description: This action sets the bandwidth rate limit schedule for a specified gateway.

subcommands.name: put-hypervisor-property-mappings
subcommands.description: This action sets the property mappings for the specified hypervisor.

subcommands.name: put-maintenance-start-time
subcommands.description: Set the maintenance start time for a gateway.

subcommands.name: start-virtual-machines-metadata-sync
subcommands.description: This action sends a request to sync metadata across the specified virtual machines.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Tag the resource.

subcommands.name: test-hypervisor-configuration
subcommands.description: Tests your hypervisor configuration to validate that backup gateway can connect with the hypervisor and its resources.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes tags from the resource.

subcommands.name: update-gateway-information
subcommands.description: Updates a gateway's name.

subcommands.name: update-gateway-software-now
subcommands.description: Updates the gateway virtual machine (VM) software.

subcommands.name: update-hypervisor
subcommands.description: Updates a hypervisor metadata, including its host, username, and password.
